query: I am from Turkey working in aerospace studies. Are there any open calls or upcoming calls that would be relevant for me?
response:
As an intelligent research assistant, I can provide a comprehensive overview of relevant open and upcoming funding opportunities for aerospace studies under Horizon Europe.

### 1. Eligibility Status (Turkey)

First and foremost, **Turkey is an Associated Country** to the Horizon Europe programme. This means Turkish organizations (universities, research institutes, SMEs, and large companies) are **fully eligible** to participate in collaborative projects (RIA, IA, CSA) and benefit from individual grants (ERC, MSCA) on the same terms as EU Member States. Your organization is eligible for **100% funding** for Research and Innovation Actions (RIA) and full personnel funding for MSCA and ERC grants.

### 2. Relevant Horizon Europe Clusters and Calls

Aerospace studies fall primarily under **Cluster 4: Digital, Industry & Space**, specifically the 'Space' component, which covers both upstream (launchers, satellites, technology) and downstream (applications using Copernicus and Galileo data) activities.

Below are examples of currently open or upcoming topics relevant to aerospace research, with a focus on calls from the 2025/2026 Work Programmes (as identified in the search):

#### A. Downstream Space Applications (Cluster 4 / EUSPA)

These calls focus on leveraging EU space infrastructure (Copernicus Earth Observation and EGNOS/Galileo navigation) for services and products, often involving data processing, AI, and integration into vertical markets (e.g., energy, climate, agriculture, smart cities). These topics are typically managed by EUSPA (European Union Agency for the Space Programme).

| # | Call ID | Title | Deadline | Focus | Expected EU Contribution |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **HORIZON-EUSPA-2026-SPACE-02-51** | Space Data Economy | 24 February 2026 | Fostering the commercialisation and mass adoption of EU space data (Copernicus/Galileo) in priority areas like Energy, Climate Adaptation, and Urban environments. | EUR 10.0 million |

#### B. Cross-Cutting Missions (Mission Adaptation)

Some technologies developed in aerospace can be applied directly to EU Missions. This call is cross-cutting but often applies to high-TRL solutions that address societal challenges.

| # | Call ID | Title | Deadline | Focus | Scope |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | **HORIZON-MISS-2026-07-CROSS-03** | Advancing lead markets and proof-of-concept for deep tech solutions contributing to EU Missions | 31 March 2026 | Scaling deep tech solutions (up to TRL 7) relevant to EU Missions (Climate Adaptation, Ocean, Cities, Soil, Cancer). This could include advanced monitoring or communication technology. | Up to 50% procurement |

**Recommendation:** Review the full **Cluster 4 Work Programme** (Destinations 6: Space) for specific topics related to next-generation satellite technology, in-orbit servicing, and strategic space infrastructure, as the majority of high-TRL aerospace/launcher calls are published there.

### 3. Individual and Foundation Grants (Thematic Neutral)

Since your area is highly specialized, you should also consider thematic-neutral opportunities that fund excellent research in **any field**, including aerospace:

#### Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA)

MSCA supports researcher mobility, training, and career development. These are highly relevant for individual researchers moving between sectors or countries.

*   **MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships (MSCA-PF)**: Supports experienced researchers (PhD holders) to undertake research abroad (1-2 years) at an EU or Associated Country host institution. This is a highly competitive individual grant (approx. €200-300K per fellow). The annual call deadline is typically in **September**.
*   **MSCA Doctoral Networks (MSCA-DN)**: Supports consortia in training doctoral candidates through international and inter-sectoral networks. Excellent for building PhD programmes in specialized aerospace fields.

#### European Research Council (ERC)

ERC funds pioneering, high-risk/high-gain **frontier research** (Excellence is the sole criterion). Grants are substantial and open to researchers of any nationality, provided the research is conducted at a host institution in the EU or an Associated Country (like Turkey).

*   **ERC Starting Grants (€1.5M)**: For researchers 2-7 years post-PhD.
*   **ERC Consolidator Grants (€2M)**: For researchers 7-12 years post-PhD.
*   **ERC Advanced Grants (€2.5M)**: For established research leaders.

### Next Steps and Actionable Resources

To find the most precise and up-to-date topics for your specific area of aerospace research (e.g., manufacturing vs. satellite operations):

🎯 **Getting Started with Horizon Europe:**
• Register on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home)
• Review the specific **[Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON)** for **Cluster 4** (Digital, Industry & Space) - Destination 6 is focused on Space.
• Search specific open calls by keywords (e.g., 'launcher', 'in-orbit servicing') via the [Call Calendar](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-calendar)
• Find partners using [Partner Search](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/partner-search) if you plan to apply for collaborative Cluster 4 calls.
